##### Project general facts

London Square Twickenham Green is an exclusive gated community of three and four-bedroom family houses. It features Bakers Mews, a collection of contemporary homes with generous living spaces and private gardens. Each house is arranged over several floors, with open-plan kitchen and dining areas leading out to the garden and bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms on the upper levels.

The houses come with private landscaped gardens, and the gated setting creates a calm environment for family life.

Interiors are designed for energy-efficient, low-maintenance living, with contemporary specifications throughout. Kitchens are laid out for a fridge freezer, oven and washer dryer, and the principal bedrooms come with en-suite bathrooms.

##### Parking

Private parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Twickenham is a riverside town in the London Borough of Richmond upon Thames, named among The Sunday Times Best Places to Live. The area is known for its independent cafés and restaurants, riverside walks along the Thames and the open space of Twickenham Green, with neighbouring Richmond and Teddington close by.

Twickenham station offers direct trains to London Waterloo, making central London comfortably accessible. Highly regarded schools and green spaces are all within easy reach.

Twickenham offers space for family life and a more relaxed pace while keeping central London within reach. Its schools, green spaces and direct rail links make the neighbourhood a well-connected choice for families.
